scripts.build:sdk: cd node_modules/@rarefriends/friendsdk && npm install && cd ../../.. && node scripts/patch-friendsdk.mjs && cd node_modules/@rarefriends/friendsdk && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:game
scripts.check: npm run build:sdk && node node_modules/@rarefriends/friendsdk/scripts/dev-game.mjs check game
scripts.test:game: npm run build:sdk && node node_modules/@rarefriends/friendsdk/scripts/dev-game.mjs test game --width 960
scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk && node node_modules/@rarefriends/friendsdk/scripts/dev-game.mjs dev game --outdir dist
